description: My name is Esther Agbaje, and I’m honored to serve as the State Representative for District 59B. As a renter, transit rider, lawyer, and public servant, I understand the challenges families in our district face every day. I came to the legislature to fight for a Minnesota that works for all of us, where every resident has a safe place to live, reliable transit options, and opportunities to thrive.
